IMPLEMENT EXACTLY THESE FILES (paths relative to the working directory above):

1. package.json — name "@module-hub/rate-limit", version "0.1.0", type "module", main "./index.ts", exports { ".": "./index.ts" }, scripts { test: "vitest run", typecheck: "tsc --noEmit" }, devDependencies { typescript ^5.6.3, vitest ^2.1.4 }. Match the http-client reference shape.

2. tsconfig.json — target ES2022, module ES2022, moduleResolution Bundler, lib ["ES2022"], strict true, skipLibCheck true, noImplicitOverride true, noUnusedLocals true, noUnusedParameters true, include ["**/*.ts"]. (Match http-client reference; do NOT add DOM lib unless needed.)

3. vitest.config.ts — minimal config using defineConfig from 'vitest/config'. Do NOT enable coverage thresholds (that is a later stage's concern). Keep it simple.

4. core/types.ts — export ALL exact types from DESIGN.md section 3: CheckRateLimitInput, RateLimitResult, RateLimitConfig, StoreConsumeParams, StoreConsumeResult, RateLimitStore (interface with consume(params): Promise<StoreConsumeResult> and optional reset?(key?: string): Promise<void>), MemoryStoreOptions. Use the exact field names and JSDoc from DESIGN.md.

5. core/error.ts — export RateLimitError class (extends Error) with readonly code: 'RATE_LIMITED', status: 429, retryable: true, key, limit, windowMs, resetAt, retryAfterMs, details: Record<string, unknown>. Constructor takes { key, limit, windowMs, resetAt, retryAfterMs, message? }. Default message: `Rate limit exceeded for key "<key>". Retry after <retryAfterMs>ms.` details = { key, limit, windowMs, remaining: 0, resetAt, retryAfterMs }. Also export RateLimitConfigError class (extends Error) with readonly code: 'RATE_LIMIT_INVALID_CONFIG', retryable: false. Also export the ErrorShape type per DESIGN.md section 7.2.

6. core/config.ts — input validation helpers (fail fast). Validate per DESIGN.md section 8.1: key must be non-empty string (trim().length > 0), limit must be integer > 0, windowMs must be number > 0, cost must be integer >= 1 (default 1), now must be finite number > 0 if provided (default Date.now()). Throw RateLimitConfigError with code 'RATE_LIMIT_INVALID_CONFIG' on any failure. Also resolve defaults from RateLimitConfig (defaultLimit, defaultWindowMs, throwOnLimitExceeded default true).

7. core/limiter.ts — export createRateLimiter(config?: RateLimitConfig): RateLimiter and checkRateLimit(input, store?, config?): Promise<RateLimitResult>. RateLimiter interface: { check(input): Promise<RateLimitResult>; checkOrThrow(input): Promise<RateLimitResult> }. Implement the fixed-window algorithm per DESIGN.md section 6: windowStart = Math.floor(now / windowMs) * windowMs, resetAt = windowStart + windowMs, remaining = max(0, limit - currentCount), retryAfterMs = 0 if allowed else max(0, resetAt - now). Validate inputs first (fail fast). Default store = createMemoryStore() if none injected. checkOrThrow throws RateLimitError when blocked (or when throwOnLimitExceeded is true). check() returns the result without throwing.

8. adapters/memory-store.ts — export createMemoryStore(options?: MemoryStoreOptions): RateLimitStore. Implement MemoryRateLimitStore per DESIGN.md section 5: internal Map<string, WindowBucket> where WindowBucket = { windowStart, count, expiresAt }. consume(params) is atomic per key: compute currentWindowStart = Math.floor(now / windowMs) * windowMs; if no bucket OR now >= bucket.expiresAt OR bucket.windowStart !== currentWindowStart, initialize new bucket { windowStart: currentWindowStart, count: 0, expiresAt: currentWindowStart + windowMs }. If bucket.count + cost <= limit: increment count, return { currentCount, windowStart, resetAt: expiresAt, allowed: true }. Else: do NOT increment, return { currentCount, windowStart, resetAt: expiresAt, allowed: false }. Passive eviction: when Map size exceeds maxKeys (default 10000), do a fast linear sweep removing expired buckets (now >= expiresAt). NO setInterval / background loops. Implement optional reset?(key?) to clear a key or all keys. Include a clear doc comment warning that MemoryRateLimitStore is NOT suitable for distributed production (single-process only).

9. adapters/index.ts — export { createMemoryStore } from './memory-store.js'; and re-export the RateLimitStore type.

10. core/index.ts — re-export the public API: createRateLimiter, checkRateLimit, RateLimitError, RateLimitConfigError, createMemoryStore (or re-export from adapters), and all public types (CheckRateLimitInput, RateLimitResult, RateLimitConfig, RateLimitStore, MemoryStoreOptions, ErrorShape).

11. index.ts (module root entry) — re-export the full public API from core/index.ts and adapters/index.ts, matching the http-client reference style.

12. tests/ — write MINIMAL smoke tests (vitest) so `npm test` passes. This is NOT the full 12-case suite (that is Stage 3/4's job). Cover at least: first request allowed, remaining decrements, limit reached blocks, window reset clears counter, independent keys, invalid config throws RateLimitConfigError, and memory store concurrent consume. Put them under tests/ (e.g. tests/limiter.test.ts, tests/memory-store.test.ts, tests/config.test.ts). Keep them focused and passing.
